text: Welcome to Acme Corp! This guide covers your first 90 days. Please read it in full before your start date.

heading_path: Welcome to Acme Corp! > Week 1: Orientation and Setup

text: Day 1 Checklist Pick up your MacBook Pro from IT (Room 201, Austin HQ) or confirm shipping address for remote employees. Activate your Acme Corp email at firstname.lastname@acmecorp.example.com . Enroll in Okta SSO and set up a FIDO2 hardware key (YubiKey 5 provided by IT) as your primary MFA factor. Join Slack: download the app and sign in with your Acme Corp email. Join #general, #engineering, and your team channel. Complete mandatory Day 1 training modules in Acme Academy: Information Security Awareness (30 min) Code of Conduct (20 min) Privacy and Data Handling (25 min)
heading_path: Welcome to Acme Corp! > Week 1: Orientation and Setup > Day 1 Checklist

Welcome to Acme Corp! > Week 2: Team Integration

text: Your Buddy Program Every new hire is paired with an Onboarding Buddy for 90 days. Your buddy is a peer (not your manager) who helps you navigate Acme Corp culture, answers "silly" questions, and introduces you to the broader team. Schedule a 30-minute coffee chat with your buddy in Week 1. Your buddy's name will be in your onboarding Jira ticket.
heading_path: Welcome to Acme Corp! > Week 2: Team Integration > Your Buddy Program

text: Key Meetings to Attend Engineering All-Hands : Every other Wednesday, 10:00–11:00 AM CT. Company-wide engineering updates. Team Stand-up : Daily, 9:15 AM CT (or team's preferred time). 15 minutes max. Sprint Planning : Every 2 weeks (Monday of sprint start). Your manager will add you to the calendar invite. 1:1 with Manager : Weekly, 30 minutes. First meeting should happen in Week 1.
heading_path: Welcome to Acme Corp! > Week 2: Team Integration > Key Meetings to Attend
Welcome to Acme Corp! > Month 1: Ramp Up

text: Development Environment Setup Follow the instructions in the README.md at the root of each repository. The main platform repo is at github.com/acmecorp/platform . Setup takes roughly 45–60 minutes for a fresh machine. Prerequisites installed via the Acme Dev Bootstrap script : Homebrew, Docker Desktop, Python 3.12+, Node.js 20 LTS, Go 1.22+ kubectl, Helm, Terraform CLI AWS CLI v2 (configured via SSO, not static keys)
heading_path: Welcome to Acme Corp! > Month 1: Ramp Up > Development Environment Setup

text: Your First PR By the end of Month 1, you should have opened at least one pull request. Common starter tasks are labeled "good-first-issue" in GitHub. Talk to your manager if you don't have a ticket by Day 14.
heading_path: Welcome to Acme Corp! > Month 1: Ramp Up > Your First PR

text: 30-60-90 Day Goals Milestone Goal 30 days Understand the product end-to-end; complete onboarding modules; first PR merged 60 days Own a small feature or bug fix from spec to production; completed code review of at least 5 PRs 90 days Contributing independently; writing design docs; participating in on-call rotation (Eng roles)
heading_path: Welcome to Acme Corp! > Month 1: Ramp Up > 30-60-90 Day Goals

text: Expense Reimbursement Submit all reimbursable expenses via Concur within 30 days of incurring the expense. Late submissions (after 90 days) are not reimbursed. Pre-approval is required for any single expense over $500 . Send approval requests to your manager and cc finance@acmecorp.example.com. Corporate credit cards (Brex) are issued to employees at L5 and above, and to anyone in Sales or Customer Success.
heading_path: Welcome to Acme Corp! > Expense Reimbursement

text: Payroll Acme Corp runs payroll on a semi-monthly schedule : the 15th and last business day of each month. Direct deposit takes 1–2 business days to settle. Payroll provider: ADP . You will receive an email from ADP to set up direct deposit in your first week.
